items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: She used to call me Newly all the time.

ctx.x: And then Otis Johnson, you know, the trumpet player - boy, Otis was a killer. He can't gamble, if he play cards if he lose, he want to fight. Another time you came to Connecticut -
Hartford, Connecticut. That's what I tried to tell them but you shut me up. Midge Williams?

So he wanted his autograph. Sunday morning I think it was. So he always carried this pistol, a gold pistol. So a kid, he just asked, can I have your autograph please. He took out his pistol and started fighting. He shot up in the air and he whipped that kid over the automobile that was parked outside...
